sermon.title: Grace, Peace, Kings, & Priests - February 26, 2023
sermon.speaker: Michael Silla
sermon.summary: Revelation 1 shows four things about the church: grace—being under the influence of Christ; peace—by submitting to God’s word; kings—reigning over sin, Satan and the flesh; and priests—ministering to God and sharing His touch with the world.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear.

scriptures.text_nkjv: But their minds were blinded. For until this day the same veil remains unlifted in the reading of the Old Testament, because the veil is taken away in Christ. But even to this day, when Moses is read, a veil lies on their heart. Nevertheless when one turns to the Lord, the veil is taken away. Now the Lord is the Spirit; and where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is liberty. But we all, with unveiled face, beholding as in a mirror the glory of the Lord, are being transformed into the same image from glory to glory, just as by the Spirit of the Lord.

faqs.question: What does “under the influence” mean?
faqs.answer: Your mind altered by alcohol or drugs—or by Christ.

faqs.question: What did Rehoboam say?
faqs.answer: That his little finger would be thicker than his father’s.

faqs.question: How do you avoid pressure?
faqs.answer: Keep yourself from situations where people push you to do wrong.

faqs.question: Do we need to fight other groups?
faqs.answer: No—not Jews or Gentiles, men or women.

faqs.question: Are leaders reigning over darkness?
faqs.answer: Many famous people and leaders are not.

faqs.question: Is he here to sell something?
